svg.title: Operational analysis: all seven entities
svg.desc: Seven entity classes share id, version, createdAt and updatedAt. Analysis targets Subject and owns Assertion, QueryRun and Assessment. QueryRun acquires Evidence. Assessment pins Assertion versions and cites Evidence versions. Review records a decision on an exact Assessment. Evidence, Assessment and Review are immutable at version 1.

g.text: All identities are workspace scoped. Every retained version is immutable.
Exact historical reference: EntityRef {kind, id, version} · an owned value
Selected attributes · all eight associations · arrows show references and ownership, not delete cascades
